headline: NYM @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 4.11 at TOR 3.67, with a projected total of 7.78. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYM moved -0.35 runs while TOR moved -0.51, changing the projected margin by +0.16 runs. The projected total fell -0.87, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Nolan McLean has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, Juan Soto, Bo Bichette, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty, Brandon Valenzuela because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
